name: @pipeworx/mcp-crypto-fng

tools.name: current_index
tools.description: Get today's Crypto Fear & Greed Index — a 0–100 market-sentiment gauge for crypto (0 = Extreme Fear, 100 = Extreme Greed). Returns the current value, its classification, the date, and seconds until the next daily update. Keyless.

tools.name: index_history
tools.description: Get historical Crypto Fear & Greed Index values (most recent first), plus a summary (latest, average, min, max). Each entry has a date, the 0–100 value, and its classification. Keyless.

limit.description: Number of days of history to return (default 30, max 365).

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-crypto-fng forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the crypto-fng pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
